compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns IN (VIN) whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns ADJ/GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns GND (GND) whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns VOUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP7361C-33E-13 assigns OUT (VOUT) whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB assigns VIN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN). Soldering LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB onto a AP7361C-33E-13 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (GND vs VOUT) — direct swap will short power rails.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: AP7361C-33E-13 is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 2.2 µF, p.1), whereas LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB can trigger control-loop oscillation.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP7361C-33E-13 is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB at 15 V rec. (20 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs by 860 mV (AP7361C-33E-13: 340 mV p.5 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 1200 mV p.8); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo at cold/hot corners.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 44% (AP7361C-33E-13: 110 °C/W p.6 vs LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB: 61.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AP7361C-33E-13 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-223-3) and LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs GND), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (VOUT vs VIN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 60 µA (p.5) vs 5000 µA (p.8), max output current is 1000 mA (p.4) vs 800 mA (p.7), recommended Vin,max is 6 V (p.4) vs 15 V (p.4), typical dropout is 340 mV (p.5) vs 1200 mV (p.8), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs ESR-constrained. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 110 vs 61.6 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
